action_cost_accounting.common_step_count: ONE physical known-delivered t4 step for every still-active controller world, but nonzero target perturbation causes extra native displacement, which MUST be recorded separately
action_cost_accounting.bound: native normalized action components within [-1,1], 6D arm SO3 unchanged, no gripper probe; this is a pre-specified fixed excitation, NOT an optimized information-theoretic or collision-certified probe
action_cost_accounting.privileged_native_target_getters: count only any native target getter the policy actually consumes at t5; post-step audit private target getters never enter public method decisions
action_cost_accounting.public_observations: two achieved public XYZ readings at t4 before and after exactly one physical step for each of two public methods; query control uses no public pose to select hidden native target

methods.M0: zero t4 native 6D action, four-hypothesis public XYZ model with original frozen per-task epsilon and competitor margin 0.002m, or 1 counted target read at t5
methods.M1: fixed nonzero t4 known delivered native action, update all four complete target histories with same acknowledged 6D probe, then public XYZ residual to shifted hypotheses with SAME frozen original epsilon and margin; if no unique winner, 1 counted target read at t5
methods.M2: fixed nonzero SAME t4 known delivered native action, always one counted authoritative native target getter at t5, physically independent PPO/controller state
methods.other_actual_physx_controls: unchanged source, always-private oracle, optimistic, exact common safety refusal, robust no read, selective robust-then-read, fixed query after neutral zero, assume-held zero-read
methods.model_warning: Old response epsilon calibrated on zero neutral action; transferring it to a nonzero native perturbation is unverified and may increase model miscoverage. Source auditor MUST score wrong confident history against real after-step target and retain all failures.
methods.physics_safety: Normalized command clipping is NOT collision/force safety certification; no real hardware or real transport loss

evaluation_primary: actual frozen PPO task success by same seed and all four true ACK histories
privileged native target getter counts and read latency if available
public authorizations and wrong-confident full history labels (after-step audit target is ONLY audit)
physical actual t4 target change and achieved XYZ displacement for nonzero probe, one vs zero
matched nonzero-probe explicit query comparator M2, not a zero-probe always-read baseline alone
all 32 true physical initial states; no discarded intervention failures
decision: This is a *pilot*. If M1 improves no valid outcome, record negative and STOP.
